rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Julunggul, the great python and respected Yolngu water-hole guardian.
ANATOMY: one python head, two eyes, one massive continuous limbless snake body, no wings; choose the single-body great-python variant [julunggul-c04, julunggul-c05].
MOMENT: surge upward out of the dark water hole toward the viewer, head above the close foreground, enormous coils displacing water, watchful guardian authority.
POWER: monsoon rain driven sideways by west wind; water splashing naturally from the emerging great snake [julunggul-c13]. No rainbow glow or invented magic.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low water-level angle; great python fills almost the entire frame, small distant trees establish scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm break in monsoon cloud rim-lights the wet head, deep walnut shadows, heavy wind-driven rain.
SURFACE: wet dark python scales, rough riverbank earth, water beads.
SETTING: its special Arnhem Land water hole, dark bank and distant vegetation [julunggul-c09].
MOOD: awe-inspiring revered guardian, imposing and dignified, never evil, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; exactly one head, no limbs or wings; no design borrowed from film, game, anime or comic; no nudity, victims or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Great Python satu tubuh muncul dari water hole.

visual_requirements.description: Ular piton agung satu kepala, tubuh tanpa anggota; varian satu tubuh.
Angin monsun membawa hujan; cipratan fisik kemunculan ular.
Penjaga situs dihormati, bukan monster jahat.

aura: Keagungan Great Python c05 dan monsun c13, bukan aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan rim light hangat editorial; gerakan naik interpretasi kemunculan dari habitat, tanpa klaim adegan historis.
Tidak memakai varian double body opsional; tidak menampilkan korban.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 dan200px dilihat: tujuh Uji Sangar ya. Piton agung memenuhi bingkai; naik dari air aktif; hujan c13/cipratan fisik; kepala1 tanpa limbs; tiada tulisan; guardian monumental bukan hewan biasa.

root_visual_review.notes: Single great python, one head and no limbs, rising out of the water hole as monsoon rain sweeps in; reads as a revered power, not a villain.
